node.title: N=256 square-mass-16 signed-chord collision gate
node.statement: In the profile-(3,4,0) residual 0<V<=76, let D_64 be the squared weight of diameter chords and C the signed cross sum between distinct support chords of equal non-diameter circular length. Exact negacyclic energy gives V/2=102-D_64+2C. Diameter chords form a matching of weight at most 21, so C<=-22. Thus every residual support has an oppositely signed equal-chord pair, is not circular Sidon, and lies on a signed three-term-progression or four-point-parallelogram template.
node.notes: ROUTE REDUCTION 2026-07-27: converts the analytic low-variance residual into an exact additive-relation classification gate. It does not enumerate or exclude the resulting templates.
